flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.description: A heavy EVA flashlight. The battery indicator flickers between one bar and none.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: Bent at the end, as if someone already tried to force a door with it.

power_cell.name: Power Cell
power_cell.description: A fist-sized cell, still warm. The label reads BRIDGE AUX.

command_center.refused: The bridge door is dead. Its panel has an empty slot marked BRIDGE AUX.

goal.text: You slot the power cell into the bridge door. The consoles wake one by one, and the ship's AI says your name. You made it.
